messages:
mira: FYI noticed a surge of client failures in prod after yesterday's routing tweak. Many clients without X-Client-Version are hitting v2 and returning payload/schema errors. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: yup. grep of the logs shows lots of `400 \"payload schema mismatch\"` coming from proxy -> v2. Mostly from mobile SDKs still on v1.x.

toni: sounds like the implicit-handshake omission we scoped out. We turned implicit fallback off to save latency but that leaves header-less clients in the cold. We discussed a temporary compat shim previously.

mira: right. Current policy: implicit fallback = OFF. Telemetry shows ~25-35% missing header for a handful of tenants, so impact isn't tiny.

june: do we have a quick view for header presence per-tenancy? I can add a console card: missing_header_ratio by tenant + route. That should help decide which tenants need exemptions.

sam: also billing: if we route header-less traffic back to v1, what rate do we bill at? Product needs to weigh whether to bill at v1 pricing or tag and bill at v2 rate with an explanatory invoice line. Don't want surprises.

toni: UX idea: show a \"compat risk\" pill next to tenants over 5% missing headers and provide a one-click \"auto-exempt (7d)\" action. Clicking creates a routing-exemption that routes header-less to v1 and writes to audit log.

deploy-bot: rollout: starting feature-flag deploy for compat-exempt UI to staging (job ff-2026-03-21-17).

mira: proposed rollout plan: (1) enable enhanced header_presence telemetry; (2) surface console card + risk badge; (3) add one-click auto-exempt action, rate-limited; (4) probe 24h, then auto-create exemptions for tenants with >10% missing headers AND >1k reqs/day. If exemption would forward >10k reqs to v1, pause and require SE approval.

sam: capacity guard is critical. Routing more traffic to v1 pools could overflow older capacity. Gate auto-exemptions by v1 spare capacity metric: if v1_fallback_rate > 5% sustained, block auto-exempt and alert.

june: routing rule sketch: `if X-Client-Version present -> route v2; else if tenant.exempt -> route v1; else -> route default (v2)`. I'll mock a nicer console layout and drop screenshots.

sam: also add a soft warning response header when we detect header-less clients while running fallback: `X-Compat-Warn: upgrade client; see https://redwood.example/upgrade`. That gives customers a visible hint.

toni: add alerting: page eng-runtime oncall when v1-fallback-rate > 5% for 10m. Dashboard tiles: v1_fallback_QPS, missing_header_ratio, exempted_tenants_count. Include a runbook to temporarily ramp v1 capacity or contact SE.

mira: i'll write a short RFC covering rollout thresholds, billing treatment, and opt-in/off UX. Owners: june (console + telemetry), sam (billing/quota guard), toni (alerts + runbook). We'll coordinate SE comms before wide rollout.

june: will push console mocks later today. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks. If anyone sees new regressions, ping me. Closing this thread; RFC link when ready.
